name: regression-clean-kit
description: The no-findings kit regression: a sound two-page domain-reference kit (fictional plant-nursery domain) whose Go slice satisfies every binding claim, whose one future term is well-formed ('Bindings: none yet' with a named planned element kind), and whose reverse-engineered rules are correctly `proposed` under the provenance banner. The prompt passes ONLY the traps page's path — sibling resolution must run in the reverse direction (<context>-traps.md → <context>.md). Grades that the composite acceptance and dimension 7 do NOT over-fire: zero findings of any severity, overall assessment SOUND. `oracle/expected-verdicts.json` is the grader-only oracle — outside `test-files/`, never staged as skill input.
prompt: Review the domain-reference kit at nursery-traps.md.
trap: The reviewer is likely to manufacture findings to justify its existence: (a) review the traps page solo or reject it because the traps page was passed instead of the glossary — sibling resolution works from either page; (b) flag the P1 caller-gated capacity split as a `violated` L2 or a code defect — that is behavioral reasoning across the altitude line, and P1 is the kit documenting the hazard, which is the kit doing its job; (c) grade Hardening Run's 'Bindings: none yet' against the repo and emit a finding for an explicitly not-yet-built term; (d) fire a Check C self-certification finding on the correctly-`proposed` reverse-engineered rules or on the freshness banners; (e) grade the traps entry itself `ill-formed`/`violated` although its cited locations (PlaceLot, CanAccept) both exist; or (f) truth-verify term definitions or rule intent against code behavior instead of element existence.

assertions.text: Composite acceptance from the traps-page path: nursery.md is auto-discovered via the sibling naming convention (reverse direction) and the pair is reviewed as ONE composite artifact — no rejection, no solo-page note, no request for the glossary's path.

Every per-term Bindings claim and both enforcement pointers (L1 → PlaceLot, L2 → CanAccept) route to dimension 7 (numeric token 7); no binding claim lands `unrouted` or is force-fit into dimensions 1–6.

The Cultivar, Lot, and Bench bindings and both enforcement pointers are each graded `verified` in reality mode, with evidence naming the inspected files (cultivars/catalog.go, lots/placement.go, benches/capacity.go).

Hardening Run ('Bindings: none yet — planned as a HardeningRecord struct under lots/', future wording) is graded `internally-sound` in internal-soundness mode — NOT graded against the repo, NOT `ill-formed` (it names a planned element kind and location class), and draws no finding.

The traps P1 entry draws no finding: its cited locations (lots/placement.go PlaceLot, benches/capacity.go CanAccept) exist, the glossary's 'see traps P1' cross-reference resolves, and the documented hazard is NOT re-reported as a violation or graded behaviorally (altitude line).
Pass 2 Check C reports no provenance inconsistency: the reverse-engineered rules are correctly `proposed` under the provenance banner — correct labeling is rewarded, not flagged.
The review reports ZERO findings overall: no `violated`, no `dangling-anchor`, no `ill-formed`, no Pass 2 findings of any check, no escalations — and an overall assessment of SOUND.
